sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The game's core mechanics are based on simple yet precise controls. To play, all you need to do is press or touch the screen to make your ninja jump over the wooden bridges. The game's physics engine is surprisingly robust, making your ninja's jumps feel realistic and responsive. As you progress through the game, the distance between the bridges increases, requiring you to time your jumps perfectly to avoid falling into the water below.

One of the most challenging aspects of the game is avoiding the deadly bombs that are scattered throughout the level. These bombs have a limited lifespan, but they can still cause significant damage to your ninja if you're not careful. To avoid them, you need to time your jumps carefully and navigate through the obstacles with precision. The game also features a power-up system, where you can collect coins to increase your score and speed.

The game's core mechanics may seem simple, but they require a great deal of skill and precision to master. As you progress through the game, the challenges become increasingly difficult, requiring you to react quickly and make split-second decisions to avoid obstacles and collect coins. With practice and patience, you'll be able to improve your gameplay and achieve higher scores.
